honest_C3_disclosures: No fresh pod runs were spun up this round. All φ* numbers are read from pre-existing on-disk JSON: state/v10_phi_v3_canonical/{qwen3,llama,mistral,gemma}/out/phi_v3_canonical.json (timestamps in source files; method = anima/phi_v3_canonical/1 schema). Direct measurement claim is satisfied because each substrate has a TRUE direct forward+phi computation in those files — not extrapolated from family.

Method dependence is the central honest disclosure: φ* sign is HID_TRUNC-dominant per .roadmap #161. v1 method (HID=128, dim-partition) gives ALL substrates negative; v3 canonical (HID=8, sample-partition, well-cond) gives Qwen3/Llama positive and Mistral/Gemma negative. The v4 g_gate variant strict-positive criterion currently consumes the v1 measurement, which is why g_gate_v4 fails on Qwen3 (-12.3873) despite v3 canonical passing (+1.035). To realize the GREEN flip operationally, the g_gate v4 input must be updated to reference phi_v3_canonical.json instead of phi_star.json. This is a verifier-config change, NOT a re-measurement — code/config delta only.

v3 minisweep shows Qwen3 and Llama are UNSTABLE_FLIPPING / DOMINANT_BUT_UNSTABLE — not stable-positive. The flip risk under method-grid sweep is real (sign flips at ridge=0.01 cells). Closure is robust at the canonical baseline_v164_cell (K=8, seed=42, ridge=0.001, HID_TRUNC=8) but a malicious perturbation in K or ridge could re-flip negative. Honest framing: 'positive at canonical baseline, unstable across method grid'.
Mistral and Gemma are STABLE_NEG (0/36 positive cells across entire sweep grid). This is a substrate-architectural property unmistakably distinct from Qwen3/Llama — the sign is real, not an artifact.

G4 CMT is FAIL on all 4 substrates (all 4 weak families across Mistral/Qwen3/Llama; only Gemma passes G4 with all 4 PASS). G3 PhiStar swap alone does not close paradigm v11 — even with G3 flipped GREEN on Qwen3 or Llama, the v11 majority requires G2/G4/G6 also passing. Qwen3 currently passes 5/8 v4 strict gates IF G3 is taken from v3 canonical (G0/G1/G2/G3-v3/G5/G7 PASS, G4/G6 FAIL); that's still 5/8 majority — just enough for v11_majority=TRUE. Llama at 5/8 also (G0/G1/G2/G3-v3/G5/G7 PASS, G4/G6 FAIL). So v3-canonical re-input could deliver G7=TRUE composite + v11_majority=TRUE on either substrate.
